title: Approve source baseline, contracts and decision register
acceptance: Review original 24 requirements, scope exclusions and all changes from the old prototype.
Accept or amend the grouping policy, emergency receipt semantics, demo/physical gates, and hardware/language/policy decisions.

title: Implement Deel-inspired Exaclim theme and dashboard shell
acceptance: Use the supplied screenshot reference, accessible tokens and locally served Inter; preserve UI SDK semantics.
Deliver one core screen with forecast, crew status and suggestions; emergency banner and setup are supporting flows.

title: Add authenticated supervisor identity and server-side site scope
acceptance: Use maintained session/OIDC integration; no anonymous cookie or frontend role toggle as authentication.
Enforce site scope on every read/write; separate revocable gateway credentials; test CSRF and session expiry.

title: Create durable operational schema and versioned API contracts
acceptance: Persist sites, crews, assignments, aggregate snapshots, events and acknowledgement receipts with migrations.
Forbid routine individual health/profile fields in dashboard/cloud schemas; add unique event and assignment constraints.

title: Build site and crew setup flows
acceptance: Validate crew names, coordinates and IANA timezone; empty site has an actionable setup state.
Save atomically, show inline errors, preserve unsaved edits on failure, confirm durable success.

title: Implement watch assignment and versioned issuance identity
acceptance: One active worker/crew assignment per watch; no client-forged site or assignment version.
Delayed help resolves the assignment at occurrence, not the new wearer; revoke or transfer with auditable scope.

title: Implement non-overlapping privacy groups and response filtering
acceptance: Group small crews within a site to at least three; no overlapping totals or independent small-crew breakdowns.
Suppress counts/budget below three valid contributors and invalidate prior cached group responses on membership change.

title: Extend public weather adapter to site-local today/tomorrow
acceptance: Return complete local-day hour buckets, provider/fetch/issue provenance and explicit missing hours.
Handle provider errors, timezone/DST and stale cache; never silently substitute synthetic data in operational mode.

title: Version risk classification and conservative policy interfaces
acceptance: Keep the illustrative demo policy explicitly named; obtain review before claiming occupational validity.
Expose conservative severity floor, unknown/stale behavior and policy version; do not invent clinical time-to-limit or work/rest rules.

title: Implement gateway aggregate ingestion and current crew state
acceptance: Count distinct active watches; validate counts, completeness, sequences, time provenance and privacy groups.
Advance age from measurement time; reject replay/future timestamps and preserve a known red floor under data loss.

title: Build explainable suggestions from forecast and group summary
acceptance: Use approved group statistics plus forecast, never a mean that conceals the highest severity.
Return action, window, rationale, limitations and provenance; missing summary yields manual-plan advice, not invented timings.

title: Persist and deduplicate authorized help events
acceptance: Ingest help/symptom trigger as a priority event with immutable ID and assignment version.
Preserve occurred/received times and delayed/clock quality; no raw symptom narrative or personal dose in dashboard payload.

title: Implement atomic acknowledgement receipts
acceptance: Authenticate acknowledging supervisor, persist server timestamp and return canonical receipt idempotently.
Never clear watch emergency or acknowledge other events; failed/offline receipt stays unconfirmed.

title: Build today/tomorrow forecast and high-risk windows
acceptance: Render local hours, accessible severity labels and high-risk window summaries without hover dependency.
Make source/freshness and absent data clear; do not merge across unknown hours or dates.

title: Build crew cards with grouping, completeness and freshness
acceptance: Use only allowed aggregate response fields; names do not become routine individual drilldowns.
Support loading, no crews, grouped/suppressed, stale, partially disconnected and fresh red/amber/green states.

title: Build suggested break/rotation cards
acceptance: Present action/window, explanation, data quality and advice-only wording.
Do not auto-complete a rest action or imply the suggestion overrides the crew floor.

title: Build priority named help banner and receipt feedback
acceptance: Render all unacknowledged authorized events, worker/crew/time and delayed delivery; keep help above normal cards.
Announce accessibly without trapping focus; disable repeated receipt action while pending and remove only after confirmed ack.

title: Implement live updates, bounded polling and stale/offline cache policy
acceptance: Use server events with polling fallback; reconnection invalidates old data instead of resetting sample age.
Age aggregates locally, scope allowed caches, never persist named alerts or private provisioning data, clear state on logout/site switch.

title: Implement local-only clothing/acclimatization provisioning
acceptance: Send private issuance settings directly to the watch; no server form round-trip, logs, analytics or production agent bridge access.
Validate simple reviewed options and wait for device confirmation; failure does not show issued/confirmed.

title: Qualify watch and implement autonomous alert firmware
acceptance: Select an actual programmable BLE wrist device; prove physical button, green/amber/red and vibration without phone/network.
Persist emergency and required local context through reboot; publish versioned minimal radio protocol and power evidence.

title: Build qualified shared-phone BLE gateway
acceptance: Prove exact phone/OS/watch compatibility, reconnection and background service behavior before relying on real radio.
Aggregate locally and forward only permitted fields; a simulator uses the same contract and stays visibly synthetic.

title: Implement durable queues, hop receipts and delayed-event reconciliation
acceptance: Persist events before hop acceptance; upstream deletion requires next-hop durable receipt, with replay-safe IDs.
Test phone/watch/backend restarts, queue pressure and old-assignment help after reassignment; never claim offline instant delivery.

title: Implement reviewed local acclimatization progression
acceptance: Define qualifying wear day, timezone, absence/decay, manual change and reassignment behavior with an expert.
Count days once across reboots and clock change; keep profile local and label any demo schedule unvalidated.

title: Build V1 fixtures and automated integration/browser coverage
acceptance: Use deterministic fixture clock, dates, assignments and fault injections tied to the same API contracts.
Retain useful old tests but replace obsolete five-person grouping/single-worker UI assumptions; do not mark new cases passed from old evidence.

title: Review privacy, security, retention and credential lifecycle
acceptance: Inspect APIs, storage, logs, analytics, browser caches and local provisioning for forbidden data or cross-site access.
Set actual retention policy, least-privilege access and deletion constraints for queued events; review Act 843 and relevant pilot obligations.

title: Validate usability, accessibility, performance and supported capacity
acceptance: Execute keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, responsive, outdoor/large-text and weak-network checks against stated targets.
Record p95 latency/load runs and candidate software capacity separately from physical radio capacity; no unsupported pilot claims.

title: Assemble traceable release evidence and reviewed handover
acceptance: Publish exact build/hash, execution results, source modes, known limitations and reproducible commands.
Separate Demo/B​​ench/Pilot gates, block critical failures, preserve rollback evidence and hand over demo recording separately.
